blocks.heading: Four Questions Before You Pick One Course

items.text: Nine paths is still too many to compare in your head at once.

Do you want a case-and-group MBA classroom, a reading-and-argument-heavy law degree, a data-and-modelling-heavy Economics program, or a skill-first route where a portfolio matters more than a syllabus, like UX or data analytics.
A course with a great salary ceiling that fights how you actually like to work will not survive the years it demands from you.

blocks.heading: Why Stacking Beats Picking Only One Course
rows: MA Economics or MA Public Policy
Data visualisation and one statistical tool (R, Python, or advanced Excel)
Turns a pure research or theory profile into someone consulting firms and think tanks can actually deploy on live data, which is where the higher-paying roles sit.
3-year LLB
CLAT-PG and an LLM in a specific domain (IP, tax, or tech law)
A generalist LLB caps out faster than a specialised LLM. The specialisation, not the degree alone, is what firms pay a premium for.
PG Diploma in Journalism and Mass Communication
One demonstrated digital or social-strategy skill, SEO, analytics reading, or short-form video editing
Newsroom hiring has shrunk while digital and brand-newsroom hiring has grown. The pivot skill is what keeps the journalism training relevant to where the jobs actually are now.
Digital marketing certification
One real, finished campaign with reported numbers, plus depth in one paid channel
Employers do not hire the certificate. They hire the one campaign you can walk them through with actual spend, reach, and conversion numbers attached.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: A course that pays Rs 30 LPA at year ten is not automatically better than a course that pays Rs 7 LPA at year one, if the first course needs a top-3 institute seat that most applicants never get.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: IIM fees for a recent batch range from roughly Rs 17 lakh to Rs 27 lakh, with average placement packages at the top IIMs running Rs 22-36 LPA.

figures.label: Total Education Cost
figures.source: TISS Hyderabad's public policy program costs roughly ₹1.68 lakh for the full two years, while Jindal School of Government and Public Policy runs closer to ₹4 lakh a year.

figures.label: Entry Level Pay
figures.source: The same MA Economics degree from a general, lower-ranked university typically starts closer to Rs 4-6 LPA. The subject is not what commands the premium here. The specific college, and the quantitative rigour it forces on you, is what does.

blocks.heading: PG Diploma in Journalism and Mass Communication

figures.label: Total Education Cost
figures.source: IIMC's PG diploma fees run roughly Rs 62,000-2 lakh for the year, depending on the specialisation (English or Hindi journalism, radio and TV, or advertising and PR). The average reported placement package is only Rs 3-4 LPA, though the highest reported package has touched Rs 20 LPA, a gap almost entirely explained by which newsroom or media house a graduate lands in, and whether they pivot into digital strategy or brand-side communication.

figures.label: Total Education Cost
figures.source: Advanced certificate programs cost roughly Rs 30,000-1,80,000 and run 3-9 months, while a full post-graduate diploma can run up to Rs 6 lakh over 6-12 months. Entry salaries typically start around Rs 4-6.5 LPA, rising to Rs 8-15 LPA within 3-5 years, and to Rs 20-25 LPA-plus in analytics leadership roles over a longer horizon.

figures.label: Education Budget Example
figures.source: An illustration, not a real fee: on a ₹3 lakh education budget, a tenth is ₹30,000 for the main course and a fifth is ₹60,000.

figures.label: Total Education Cost
figures.source: Bootcamp fees typically run Rs 25,000-1.5 lakh over 4-6 months, and hiring managers care far more about 3-5 strong case studies showing real user research and design decisions than about which subject you studied. Fresh bootcamp graduates commonly start around Rs 3-7 LPA, with entry-level roles at genuine product companies reaching Rs 6-15 LPA once a strong portfolio is in place, and experienced product designers earning Rs 20-35 LPA or more.
